title: any click detectors click detector script
features: use this script to log the paths of the click detectors you click so that you can make more scripts with the click detector 👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍
script:
for i, v in next, game:GetDescendants(), nil do if not v:IsA("ClickDetector") then continue end v:AddTag("Clickable") end

local cs = game:GetService("CollectionService")

for _, detector in next, cs:GetTagged("Clickable"), nil do
    detector.MouseClick:Connect(function()
    setclipboard("game."..detector:GetFullName())
    print("Copied to clipboard!")
    end) --should output which player clicked the detector
end
